title: General Chemistry I
topics: Atomic structure and the periodic table
Chemical bonding: ionic, covalent, metallic, hydrogen bonding
Chemical equilibrium and Le Chatelier's principle

items.q: An atom is written with mass number 15 and atomic number 4. How many neutrons does it contain?
items.s: Neutrons = mass number - atomic number = 15 - 4 = 11.
items.t: Atomic structure and the periodic table

items.q: A solution has hydrogen ion concentration of 1 x 10^-9 mol/L. Find its pH.

items.s: At constant volume P1/T1 = P2/T2, so P2 = 5 x 475 / 375 = 6.333 atm.

items.q: 58 g of a substance of molar mass 98 g/mol causes a rise of 16 degrees in a calorimeter, absorbing 3897.6 J. Find the molar enthalpy change, correct to two decimal places.
items.s: Moles = 58/98 and the enthalpy change per mole = q/n = 6585.6 J/mol.
